title: Dual-architecture release packaging (arm64 + x86_64) under macOS 27 codesign rules

context.interruption: Generation 11 work was interrupted mid-way through x86_64 release preparation: an x86_64 DMG had been produced but the onedir PyInstaller build overwrote release/candidate/OhMyCrypto.app with an unsigned framework-layout bundle, the bundle launcher referenced the wrong sidecar name (ohmycrypto-sidecar instead of ohmycrypto-sidecar-x86_64), and the native gate was left failing with 'code object is not signed at all'.
context.environment_change_discovered: macOS 27.0 (Build 26A428) codesign behavior changed relative to the Gen 11 signing environment. Verified empirically on this host: (1) codesign --verify --strict now classifies PyInstaller's base_library.zip as unsigned nested code, invalidating the Gen 11 arm64 bundle signature (reproduced on a fresh git-archive extraction); (2) any directory named python3.12 (even empty, even a symlink) is classified as a malformed nested bundle and cannot be signed or skipped; (3) File Provider (iCloud Desktop sync) re-adds com.apple.fileprovider.fpfs#P xattrs to release/candidate, and codesign rejects bundles carrying such detritus both when signing and when verifying in place.

solution.packaging: Both architecture sidecars are now built with PyInstaller --onefile (single Mach-O executable, no _internal tree, no Python.framework, no python3.12 directory, no base_library.zip). x86_64 is built with an architecture-matched universal2 interpreter venv (.venv-x86_64, Python 3.12.0, PyInstaller 6.22.3); arm64 uses the project .venv (Python 3.12.15, PyInstaller 6.22.3).
solution.signing: Bundles are built in a File-Provider-free staging directory (tempfile.mkdtemp), every Mach-O object and zip archive inside is signed individually, the outer bundle is signed without --deep, and the result must pass codesign --verify --strict or the release fails. The DMG is created from the pristine staging bundle so no File Provider xattrs are baked into the distributed image.
solution.verification: scripts/verify.py --gate native now fails on codesign --verify --strict (not just -dv display) and executes the bundled sidecar binary with a protocol ping. Verification runs on a cleaned temp copy to mirror a clean-user install.

limits: Ad-hoc (local) signing only: Developer ID signing and Apple notarization remain pending external authorization (prerequisite PR03).
x86_64 execution verified under Rosetta 2 on an arm64 host, which is the native-compatible route available here; no physical Intel host was used.
The standing release/candidate/OhMyCrypto.app is the arm64 build (matching the native host); the x86_64 bundle is distributed inside its DMG.
